questions.question:
If P =
√(secx - tanx)_________√(secx + tanx)
, then what is the value of tan x
questions.question_hi:
यदि P =
√(secx - tanx)_________√(secx + tanx)
है, तो tan x का मान कितना है
questions.solution:
P = √[(secx - tanx) / (secx + tanx)],

=> P = √[(1 - sin x) / (1 + sinx)]

Squaring both sides:

=> P2 = (1 - sin x) / (1 + sin x)

Applying componando and dividendo

=> (P2 + 1) / (P2 - 1) = (1 - sin x + 1 + sin x) / (1 - sin x - 1 - sin x)

=> (P2 + 1) / (P2 - 1) = -1/sin x

=> sinx = (1 - P2) / (1 + P2)

So, cosx = √[1 - (1 - P2)2 / (1 + P2)2] = 2p/(1 + p2)

So, tanx = (1 - p2)/2p

questions.question: The cost of milk is Rs.30 per litre and the cost of butter is Rs.180 per kg. 200 gram butter is prepared from 1 litre milk. If some water is mixed with the milk and its cost becomes Rs.24 per litre, then what will be the cost of butter prepared from 1 litre of mixture?
questions.question_hi: दूध की कीमत रु. 30 प्रति लीटर और मक्खन की कीमत रु. 180 प्रति किलोग्राम है। 1 लीटर दूध से 200 ग्राम मक्खन तैयार किया जाता है। यदि दूध में थोड़ी मात्रा में पानी मिलाया जाता है और उसकी कीमत रु. 24 प्रति लीटर है, तो 1 लीटर मिश्रण से तैयार मक्खन की कीमत कितनी होगी?
questions.solution:
Ratio of Amount of milk and amount of water in mixture = (24 - 0) : (30 - 24) = 4:1

Hence in 1 litre of mixture milk will be 800 ml and water is 200 ml.

Butter prepared from 1 litre of mixture that contains 800ml milk is = 200 * 800/1000 = 160 grams

Cost of 160 gram butter = 180 * 160/1000 = Rs.28.8

questions.question: The population of a district is divided between urban and rural areas in the ratio 3 : 8. During a year, the urban population increased by 24% while the rural population decreased by 7%. If the total population at the end of the year became 23,436, find the population of the district at the beginning of the year.
questions.question_hi: एक जिले की जनसंख्या शहरी और ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में 3 : 8 के अनुपात में विभाजित है। एक वर्ष के दौरान, शहरी जनसंख्या में 24% की वृद्धि हुई, जबकि ग्रामीण जनसंख्या में 7% की कमी हुई। यदि वर्ष के अंत में कुल जनसंख्या 23,436 हो गई, तो वर्ष की शुरुआत में जिले की जनसंख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Let the initial urban and rural populations be 3x and 8x respectively.

Initial total population = 11x

Final urban population = 124% of 3x

= 372x/100

Final rural population = 93% of 8x

= 744x/100

Final total population = (372x + 744x)/100

= 1116x/100

= 279x/25

Given,

279x/25 = 23,436

x/25 = 84

x = 2,100

Initial population,

11x = 23,100

questions.question: Two pillars of equal height stand on either side of a roadway that is 265 m wide. At a point in the road between pillars, the elevations of the pillars are X° and Y° so that tan X° = 27/29 and tan Y˚ = 9/8. Then, find the height of each pillar.
questions.question_hi: 265 मीटर चौड़ी एक सड़क के दोनों ओर समान ऊँचाई के दो खंभे खड़े हैं। सड़क पर खंभों के बीच एक बिंदु पर, खंभों की ऊँचाई X° और Y° है, जिससे tan X° = 27/29 और tan Y˚ = 9/8 है। तो, प्रत्येक खंभे की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
AB = CD = Height of tower

BD = BE + ED = 265 m

ED = 265 - BE m

Tan X˚ = AB/BE

27/29 = AB/BE

BE = 29 * AB/27

Tan Y˚ = CD/ED

9/8 = AB/(265 - BE)

AB * 8 = 9 (265 - BE)

8AB = 9 (265 - 29AB/27)

8AB = 9 (7155 - 29AB)/27

24AB = 7155 - 29AB

53AB = 7155

AB = 135 m

questions.question: The centroid of triangle XYZ is obtained from the coordinates X(1, 2), Y(4, 5), and Z(7, -1). A line of slope -2 passes through this centroid. What is the equation of the line in general form?
questions.question_hi: त्रिभुज XYZ के शीर्षों X(1, 2), Y(4, 5) और Z(7, −1) के निर्देशांकों से उसका केन्द्रक (Centroid) ज्ञात किया जाता है। इस केन्द्रक से होकर जाने वाली एक रेखा की ढाल −2 है। रेखा का सामान्य रूप में समीकरण क्या है?
questions.solution:
Coordinates of centroid of a triangle = {(sum of x-coordinates of the three vertices)/3, (sum of y-coordinates of the three vertices)/3}

Centroid of triangle XYZ

= {[(1 + 4 + 7)/3], [(2 + 5 - 1)/3]}

= (12/3, 6/3)

= (4, 2)

Equation of a line passing through the point (x1, y1) and having slope m,

y - y1 = m(x - x1)

Here,

x1 = 4, y1 = 2, and m = -2

y - 2 = -2(x - 4)

y - 2 = -2x + 8

2x + y - 10 = 0

Sum of the five observations:

x + (x + 3) + (x + 6) + (x + 9) + (x + 12)

= 5x + 30

Since the mean is 18:

Sum of observations = 18 * 5

= 90

Therefore:

5x + 30 = 90

5x = 60

x = 12

The first three observations are:

12, 15, 18

Mean = (12 + 15 + 18) ÷ 3

= 45 ÷ 3

= 15

questions.question: A number 19889 is to be increased by the least possible integer so that it becomes divisible by 16, 18, 20 and 21. Find that integer.
questions.question_hi: संख्या 19889 में न्यूनतम संभव कौन-सी पूर्णांक संख्या जोड़ी जाए, ताकि प्राप्त संख्या 16, 18, 20 और 21 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो जाए?
questions.solution:
Least value to be added = least common multiple of the divisors − remainder obtained when the given number is divided by that least common multiple

Let L = least common multiple of 16, 18, 20 and 21.

16 = 24

18 = 2 X 32

20 = 22 X 5

21 = 3 X 7

L = 24 X 32 X 5 X 7

L = 5040

Dividing 19889 by 5040 :

19889 = (5040 X 3) + 4769

Required value = 5040 − 4769

Required value = 271

questions.question:
P and Q alone can do a work in 28 days and 32 days respectively. R is 40% more efficient than P.

They work in the following manner:

Day 1: P works.

Day 2: Q and R work.

Day 3: P works. And so on.

On which day the work will be completed?
questions.question_hi:
अकेले P और Q एक काम को क्रमशः 28 दिनों और 32 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। R, P से 40% अधिक कुशल है।

वे निम्न प्रकार से काम करते हैं:

दिन 1: P काम करता है।

दिन 2: Q और R काम करते हैं।

दिन 3: P काम करता है और इसी प्रकार से आगे भी।

काम किस दिन पूरा होगा?
questions.solution:
P = 28 days

Q = 32 days

We know, efficiency and time are inverse of each other.

Efficiency ratio, R: P = 140/100 = 7: 5

Then, time ratio, R: P = 5: 7

R = 5/7 * 28 = 20 days

WorkersTime taken to complete the whole work aloneTotal workOne day work done
P28LCM of 28, 32 and 20 = 1120 units1120/28 = 40 units
Q321120/32 = 35 units
R201120/20 = 56 units

Day 1 = 40 units

Day 2 work = 35 + 56 = 91 units

Day 3 work = 40 units

Day 4 work = 35 + 56 = 91 units

Then, total work done from day 1 to day 2 = 91 + 40 = 131 units

So, total work done from day 1 to day 16 = 8 * 131 = 1048 units

Day 17 work = 40 days

Remaining work = 1120 - 1048 - 40 = 32 units

Q and R work on day 18. So, time taken by Q and R together to complete the remaining work = 32/91 = 0.35 days

This means the work is completed on Day 18.

Now, time taken = 67.5/(60 - 15) = 1.5 hours

questions.question:
Each item describes a situation and is followed by four possible responses. Indicate the response you find most appropriate. Choose only one response for each item. The responses will be evaluated based on the level of appropriateness for the given situation.

Rahul is preparing for SSC and must choose a place to stay for the next 10 months. One room is cheap but takes 90 minutes one-way to reach the library and coaching. The other is costlier but is 15 minutes away and includes reliable electricity for night study. Rahul's family budget is tight, but he can reduce non-essential spending to manage a slightly higher rent. Which choice is most appropriate?
questions.question_hi:
प्रत्येक प्रश्न में एक परिस्थिति दी गई है, जिसके बाद चार संभावित प्रतिक्रियाएँ दी गई हैं। वह प्रतिक्रिया चुनिए जिसे आप सबसे उपयुक्त मानते हैं। प्रत्येक प्रश्न के लिए केवल एक विकल्प चुनें। दिए गए परिस्थिति के अनुसार प्रतिक्रियाओं की उपयुक्तता के स्तर के आधार पर उनका मूल्यांकन किया जाएगा।

राहुल SSC की तैयारी कर रहा है और उसे अगले 10 महीनों के लिए रहने की जगह चुननी है। एक कमरा सस्ता है, लेकिन वहाँ से लाइब्रेरी और कोचिंग पहुँचने में एक तरफ 90 मिनट लगते हैं। दूसरा कमरा महँगा है, लेकिन वहाँ से लाइब्रेरी और कोचिंग केवल 15 मिनट की दूरी पर हैं और रात में पढ़ाई के लिए बिजली की विश्वसनीय सुविधा भी उपलब्ध है। राहुल के परिवार का बजट सीमित है, लेकिन वह गैर-ज़रूरी खर्चों को कम करके थोड़ा अधिक किराया देने की व्यवस्था कर सकता है। सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प कौन-सा है?

options.label: A
options.text_hi: पढ़ाई की जगह के पास महँगा कमरा

options.label: B
options.text: Cheaper room with a long commute
options.text_hi: लंबी दूरी तय करके आने-जाने वाला सस्ता कमरा

options.label: C
options.text_hi: हर महीने बारी-बारी से दोनों कमरों में रहना

options.label: D
options.text: Wait and decide after a month

questions.solution:
Rahul's main goal is consistent study time and routine for 10 months.

Option A saves 2.5 hours daily in commuting time, potentially increasing study time and reducing fatigue.

The budget issue is manageable by cutting non-essential spending, so the trade-off is realistic.

Option B looks cheaper but silently costs Rahul daily time, energy, and regularity.

Option C adds shifting stress and wastes money on overlap.

Option D delays a decision while the time loss continues each day.

questions.question:
Four vaccination camps were organised in Salem, Erode, Namakkal, and Karur on 12th, 13th, 14th, and 15th August.

• Salem was held earlier than Karur but later than Erode.

• Namakkal was not on 13th August.

• The camp on 15th August was not in Karur.

When was the vaccination camp in Salem organised?
questions.question_hi:
सलेम, इरोड, नामक्कल और करूर में 12, 13, 14 और 15 अगस्त को चार टीकाकरण शिविर आयोजित किए गए।

- सलेम में शिविर, करूर से पहले लेकिन इरोड के बाद आयोजित किया गया था।

- नामक्कल में शिविर 13 अगस्त को आयोजित नहीं किया गया था।

- 15 अगस्त को आयोजित शिविर करूर में नहीं था।

सलेम में टीकाकरण शिविर किस तारीख को आयोजित किया गया था?
questions.solution:
Erode was earlier than Salem, and Salem was earlier than Karur.

So, the order is:

Erode < Salem < Karur

Karur was not on 15th August.

If Karur were on 13th August, Salem would have to be before 13th August and Erode before Salem, which is not possible.

=> Karur = 14th August

Then Salem must be before 14th August and after Erode.

=> Salem = 13th August

Erode = 12th August

Namakkal = 15th August

This also satisfies that Namakkal was not on 13th August.

questions.question: If $ = division, @ = multiplication, % = addition, and # = subtraction, what is 168 $ 14 @ 11 % 36 # 28?

Here,

$ means division, @ means multiplication, % means addition, and # means subtraction.

So, 168 $ 14 @ 11 % 36 # 28

= 12 x 11 + 36 − 28

= 132 + 36 − 28

= 168 − 28

= 140

questions.question:
Read the given statement and answer the question that follows.

If I visit the supermarket, I'll buy apples.

Which of the following statements is/are definitely true?

I. If I never buy apples, I'll never visit the supermarket.

II. Out of all the items I buy at the supermarket, apples will be one of them.

III. I always visit the supermarket only to buy apples.
questions.question_hi:
दिए गए कथन को पढ़ें और उसके बाद दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दें।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन निश्चित रूप से सत्य है/हैं?

I. अगर मैं कभी सेब नहीं खरीदता/खरीदती, तो मैं कभी सुपरमार्केट नहीं जाऊंगा/जाऊंगी।

II. सुपरमार्केट से खरीदी गई सभी वस्तुओं में से सेब एक होगा/होगी।

III. मैं हमेशा सुपरमार्केट सिर्फ सेब खरीदने के लिए ही जाता/जाती हूँ।

Statement I is incorrect; the visit to supermarket is not the conditional statement and is not dependent on the act of buying apples.

Statement II is correct; the visit to the supermarket, to buy anything at all, will include apples.

Statement III is incorrect; the visit to the supermarket is not restricted to the act of buying apples only.

Hence, a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

We have:

147 ÷ 7 + 51 x 2 - 16 = 23

From a:

147 ÷ 51 + -2 = 23

21 + 46 - 16 = 51

21+ 30 = 51

Interchanging the numbers we get:

147 ÷ 7 + 51 x 16 - 2 = 23

21 + 816 - 2 = 23

So this option is not valid.

From d:

147 ÷ 7 + 51 x 2 - 16 = 23

Interchanging the numbers we get:

147 ÷ 23 + 51 x 2 - 16 = 7

147 ÷ 23 + 102 - 16 = 7

So this option is not valid.

questions.question:
Based on the following relations:

A + B means "A is the father of B";

A X B means "A is the wife of B";

A − B means "A is the sister of B";

A ÷ B means "A is the son of B".

Which of the following implies that T is the nephew of R?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित संबंधों के आधार पर:

A + B का अर्थ है "A, B का पिता है";

A X B का अर्थ है "A, B की पत्नी है";

A - B का अर्थ है "A, B की बहन है";

A ÷ B का अर्थ है "A, B का पुत्र है"।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन यह दर्शाता है कि T, R का भतीजा है?
questions.solution:
T ÷ P → T is the son of P.

P − R → P is the sister of R.

Son of R's sister = R's nephew.

Hence T is R's nephew.

So, "T ÷ P − R" is correct.

Yhprum's Law is often presented as a counterpoint to Murphy's Law. While Murphy's Law is popularly associated with the expectation that things that can go wrong may go wrong, Yhprum's Law encourages people to recognise that favourable outcomes are also possible, particularly when they are willing to act despite uncertainty. The idea is not that every effort will automatically produce success, but that excessive concern about failure can prevent people from discovering opportunities that become visible only through action. Yhprum's Law therefore shifts attention from the fear of what might go wrong to the possibility of what might go right. It does not require people to ignore risks or abandon careful planning; rather, it suggests that planning should eventually lead to action. In professional and personal life, this attitude can encourage experimentation, resilience, and confidence. The broader lesson is that success does not always follow a perfectly logical or predictable path. Sometimes, progress begins when a person stops waiting for certainty and takes a meaningful step forward.

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

I slept by the time the Premier League match between Manchester United and Liverpool was live on television.
questions.solution:
The error lies in option (d).

The past perfect tense is used when out of two actions it is necessary to emphasize that the preceding action was completely finished before the succeeding action started.

The preceding action is implied by 'by the time'.

For example: I had gone to Mumbai by the time my father came back from his trip.

Similarly, in the sentence, 'by the time' implies that the person had already 'slept' (preceding action) when the match 'was live on television' (succeeding action). So, 'had slept' (past perfect tense) must replace 'slept' (simple past) in the sentence to emphasize that the preceding action was complete before the succeeding action started.

Thus, the error is in option (d) I slept.

Therefore, the corrected form of the sentence is: I had slept by the time the Premier League match between Manchester United and Liverpool was live on television.

Additional Information:

Preceding actions are generally implied by the following as given below:

Before
After
Recently
Yet
By the time

questions.question: Select the sentence in which the '-ing' form of verb expresses the continuity of an action/event.

options.label: A
options.text: The teacher was explaining the topic when the bell rang suddenly.

options.label: B
options.text: The manager ended up confusing everyone in the room.

options.label: C
options.text: Jogging every morning is part of her daily routine now.

options.label: D
options.text: We discussed attending the seminar on digital marketing strategies.

questions.correct_text: The teacher was explaining the topic when the bell rang suddenly.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: a) The teacher was explaining the topic when the bell rang suddenly.

In this sentence, "was explaining" is a past continuous verb phrase. The "-ing" form "explaining" combined with the auxiliary verb "was" shows that the action was ongoing at the time another action occurred, which indicates continuity.

In option b), "confusing" is part of a verb phrase but does not show ongoing action - it results from the verb "ended up" and refers to the outcome, not continuity.

In option c), "jogging" is a gerund acting as the subject of the sentence and refers to a habitual action, not one in progress.

In option d), "attending" is a gerund functioning as the object of "discussed," not expressing an ongoing event.

Therefore, only option a) expresses the continuity of an action/event using the "-ing" form.

Note: Gerund: Gerund is a verb form that functions as a noun, ending in -ing. A gerund can be either the subject or object of a sentence in English. Example: "Everybody enjoyed her dancing and singing at the party." The words 'dancing' and 'singing' are gerunds.

Yhprum's Law is often presented as a counterpoint to Murphy's Law. While Murphy's Law is popularly associated with the expectation that things that can go wrong may go wrong, Yhprum's Law encourages people to recognise that favourable outcomes are also possible, particularly when they are willing to act despite uncertainty. The idea is not that every effort will automatically produce success, but that excessive concern about failure can prevent people from discovering opportunities that become visible only through action. A person may spend considerable time analysing every possible risk, waiting for the perfect plan or the ideal moment to begin. Another person, with fewer advantages or less certainty, may simply start, learn from mistakes, and continue making adjustments. Over time, such persistence can create opportunities that could not have been predicted at the beginning. Yhprum's Law therefore shifts attention from the fear of what might go wrong to the possibility of what might go right. It does not require people to ignore risks or abandon careful planning; rather, it suggests that planning should eventually lead to action. In professional and personal life, this attitude can encourage experimentation, resilience, and confidence. The broader lesson is that success does not always follow a perfectly logical or predictable path. Sometimes, progress begins when a person stops waiting for certainty and takes a meaningful step forward.

questions.question:
With reference to economic planning in India, consider the following statements regarding Five-Year Plans:

i) India launched its First Five-Year Plan in 1951 to begin its era of planned economic development.

ii) A total of thirteen Five-Year Plans were implemented before the planning model was discontinued.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में आर्थिक योजना के संदर्भ में, पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) भारत ने अपनी पहली पंचवर्षीय योजना 1951 में शुरू की ताकि अपनी योजनाबद्ध आर्थिक विकास की अवधि शुरू हो सके।

ii) कुल तेरह पंचवर्षीय योजनाएं लागू की गईं, इसके बाद योजना मॉडल को बंद कर दिया गया।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct

India's First Five-Year Plan was launched in 1951 under the Planning Commission.

It focused primarily on agriculture, irrigation, food security, and rehabilitation in the post-independence period, marking the beginning of planned economic development in the country.

questions.question: The traditional folk performance art known as Dumhal is a vibrant, celebratory dance form executed on special occasions by the men of the Wattal tribal community. This local dance form is indigenous to which of the following regions of India?
questions.question_hi: पारंपरिक लोक प्रदर्शन कला जिसे डुमहल के नाम से जाना जाता है, एक जीवंत, उत्सवपूर्ण नृत्य रूप है जो वाट्टल जनजाति के पुरुषों द्वारा विशेष अवसरों पर किया जाता है। यह स्थानीय नृत्य रूप भारत के निम्नलिखित क्षेत्रों में से किस क्षेत्र का स्वदेशी है?
questions.solution:
Dumhal is a highly specialized, local folk dance performed by the men of the Wattal tribe in Jammu and Kashmir. The dancers wear long, colorful robes along with tall, conical caps studded with beads and shells. The performance begins with a ceremonial procession where the dancers plant a large banner or wooden pole into the ground, around which the entire group leaps, drums, and sings in a synchronized circle.

(a) Himachal Pradesh is famous for folk dances like Nati and Dangi.

(c) Uttarakhand is known for traditional performance arts like Choliya and Langvir Nritya.

(d) Ladakh is celebrated for its monastic mask dances (such as Cham) and traditional social dances like Shondol.

questions.question:
Regarding the legal protection and ecological status of the Malabar Civet (Viverra civettina) in India, consider the following statements:

Statement 1: The Malabar Civet is protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.

Statement 2: This species is endemic to the Western Ghats of India and is classified as Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List.

Statement 3: The classification under Schedule I provides the Malabar Civet with the highest level of legal protection in India, attracting the stringent penalties for poaching and trade similar to those for the Bengal Tiger.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में मालाबार सिवेट (Viverra civettina) की कानूनी सुरक्षा और पारिस्थितिक स्थिति के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन 1: मालाबार सिवेट को वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम, 1972 की अनुसूची I के तहत संरक्षित किया गया है।

कथन 2: यह प्रजाति भारत के पश्चिमी घाटों की स्थानिक है और इसे IUCN रेड लिस्ट में गंभीर रूप से संकटग्रस्त (Critically Endangered) के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

कथन 3: अनुसूची I के तहत वर्गीकरण मालाबार सिवेट को भारत में उच्चतम स्तर की कानूनी सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है, जिससे इसके अवैध शिकार और व्यापार के लिए बंगाल टाइगर के समान ही कठोर दंड का प्रावधान है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Malabar Civet (also known as the Malabar large-spotted civet) is listed under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, granting it absolute legal protection in India.

Statement 2 is correct: The species is endemic to the Western Ghats region of southern India (found primarily in lowland moist evergreen forests and riparian zones). It is one of India's rarest mammals and is classified as Critically Endangered (CR) on the IUCN Red List due to extreme habitat loss, fragmentation, and hunting.

Statement 3 is correct: Inclusion in Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 confers the highest degree of legal protection under Indian law. Offences/poaching involving Schedule I species attract the maximum statutory penalties and imprisonment terms, identical to the legal safeguards provided to flagship species like the Tiger or Asian Elephant.

In 1991, India met with an economic crisis relating to its external debt - the government was not able to make repayments on its borrowings from abroad; foreign exchange reserves, which we generally maintain to import petrol and other important items, dropped to levels that were not sufficient for even a fortnight. The crisis was further compounded by rising prices of essential goods.

कथन II: इस प्रणाली के तहत, विस्तार कर रहे सिख आध्यात्मिक संगठन को 22 क्षेत्रीय इकाइयों या मंजियों में विभाजित किया गया था, जिनमें से प्रत्येक को एक विश्वसनीय स्थानीय नेता के प्रभार में रखा गया था।

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.

Guru Amar Das, the third Sikh Guru, developed the Manji system to organise the growing Sikh community and facilitate the spread of Sikh teachings.

Trusted disciples were appointed to manjis and entrusted with responsibilities connected with preaching and local organisation.

Statement II is correct

The Sikh spiritual organisation was divided into 22 manjis or regional units.

Each manji was placed under the charge of a pious and devoted Sikh who exercised responsibility within the assigned area.

Further insights:

- Guru Amar Das served as the third Sikh Guru from 1552 to 1574 CE.

- Goindwal emerged as an important Sikh centre during the period of Guru Amar Das.

- Guru Amar Das strongly opposed the practice of sati and criticised the purdah system.

- The langar institution contributed to social unity by bringing people together without caste distinctions.

- Guru Ram Das, the successor of Guru Amar Das, laid the foundations of Amritsar.

questions.question:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): Sultan Ghiyasuddin Balban introduced the strict court practices of Sijda (prostration) and Paibos (kissing the Sultan's feet) in the Delhi Sultanate.

Reason (R): Balban wanted to emphasise his theory of kingship and demonstrate that the position of the Sultan was supreme and superior to the nobility.

In the context of the statements above, which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है:

अभिकथन (A): सुल्तान गयासुद्दीन बलबन ने दिल्ली सल्तनत में सिजदा (साष्टांग प्रणाम) और पैबोस (सुल्तान के पैर चूमना) की सख्त दरबारी प्रथाओं की शुरुआत की।

कारण (R): बलबन अपने राजत्व के सिद्धांत पर जोर देना चाहता था और यह प्रदर्शित करना चाहता था कि सुल्तान का पद सर्वोच्च और कुलीनों से श्रेष्ठ था।

उपरोक्त कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

questions.solution:
Assertion (A) is true

Balban introduced and strictly enforced elaborate court ceremonies such as Sijda (prostration) and Paibos (kissing the Sultan's feet).

These practices formed part of the rigid court etiquette associated with Balban's rule.

Reason (R) is true

Balban sought to enhance the dignity and authority of the monarchy.

He believed that the Sultan occupied an exalted position and should stand above the powerful nobles who had earlier exercised considerable influence in the affairs of the Delhi Sultanate.

The Reason correctly explains the Assertion because the strict practices of Sijda (prostration) and Paibos (kissing the feet of Monarch) were used to reinforce the elevated status of the Sultan and strengthen the prestige of the monarchy.

Further insights:

- Balban ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1266 to 1287 CE.

- He adopted severe measures to suppress disturbances in Mewat and restore security around Delhi.

Reason (R): At Jupiter's orbital distance, solar radiation is completely absent, making solar panels inoperable and forcing deep-space probes to rely on specialized thermal reflection mirrors instead.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है:

अभिकथन (A): नासा (NASA) के यूरोपा क्लिपर (Europa Clipper) अंतरिक्ष यान को रेडियोआइसोटोप थर्मोइलेक्ट्रिक जनरेटर (RTGs) का उपयोग करने के बजाय, किसी अंतरग्रहीय मिशन के लिए नासा द्वारा अब तक बनाए गए सबसे बड़े सोलर एरे विंग्स (solar array wings) के साथ डिज़ाइन किया गया था।

कारण (R): बृहस्पति की कक्षीय दूरी पर, सौर विकिरण पूरी तरह से अनुपस्थित होता है, जिससे सौर पैनल निष्क्रिय हो जाते हैं और डीप-स्पेस प्रोब (deep-space probes) को इसके बजाय विशेष थर्मल रिफ्लेक्शन मिरर (thermal reflection mirrors) पर निर्भर होने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनें:

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).
options.text_hi: (A) और (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

questions.solution:
Assertion (A) is true: NASA's Europa Clipper mission features massive solar panel arrays extending over 30.5 meters (100 feet) end-to-end to capture sufficient sunlight at Jupiter's orbit. It is indeed the largest spacecraft NASA has ever developed for a planetary exploration mission.

Reason (R) is false: Solar radiation is not absent at Jupiter's distance; it is merely reduced to about 3%−4% of the sunlight received at Earth (as intensity falls off with the square of the distance, I ∝ r−2). Modern, high-efficiency solar cell technologies allow solar panels to generate sufficient electricity in this low-intensity, low-temperature environment, eliminating the strict reliance on RTGs without needing hypothetical thermal reflection mirrors.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Light and Optics:

1) A convex lens is thicker in the middle and converges parallel rays of light to a real focal point - it is used in magnifying glasses, cameras, and to correct Hypermetropia (long-sightedness).

2) A concave lens is thinner in the middle and diverges parallel rays of light - the image formed is always virtual, erect, and diminished, and it is used to correct Myopia (short-sightedness).

3) Dispersion of light through a prism occurs because different colours (wavelengths) of light travel at different speeds in the glass medium and thus refract at different angles - Violet light bends the most and Red light bends the least.

4) The critical angle for total internal reflection in glass is the same for all colours of light - dispersion does not affect the critical angle since all wavelengths travel at the same speed inside a glass prism.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्रकाश और प्रकाशिकी के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1) उत्तल लेंस बीच में मोटा होता है और प्रकाश की समानांतर किरणों को एक वास्तविक फोकस बिंदु पर अभिसरित करता है - इसका उपयोग आवर्धक लेंस (magnifying glasses), कैमरों में और दूरदृष्टि दोष (Hypermetropia) को ठीक करने के लिए किया जाता है।

2) अवतल लेंस बीच में पतला होता है और प्रकाश की समानांतर किरणों को अपसरित करता है - बनने वाला प्रतिबिंब हमेशा आभासी, सीधा और छोटा होता है, और इसका उपयोग निकट दृष्टि दोष (Myopia) को ठीक करने के लिए किया जाता है।

3) प्रिज्म के माध्यम से प्रकाश का विक्षेपण इसलिए होता है क्योंकि प्रकाश के विभिन्न रंग (तरंगदैर्ध्य) कांच के माध्यम में अलग-अलग गति से यात्रा करते हैं और इस प्रकार अलग-अलग कोणों पर अपवर्तित होते हैं - बैंगनी प्रकाश सबसे अधिक मुड़ता है और लाल प्रकाश सबसे कम मुड़ता है।

4) कांच में पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन के लिए क्रांतिक कोण प्रकाश के सभी रंगों के लिए समान होता है - विक्षेपण क्रांतिक कोण को प्रभावित नहीं करता है क्योंकि सभी तरंगदैर्ध्य कांच के प्रिज्म के अंदर समान गति से यात्रा करते हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Convex lenses converge light and form real images (except when the object is within the focal length). Hypermetropia (near objects appear blurry) is corrected with convex lenses.

Statement 2 is correct: Concave lenses always produce virtual, erect, diminished images regardless of object position. Myopia (distant objects appear blurry) is corrected with concave lenses.

Statement 3 is correct: Dispersion occurs because the refractive index of glass varies with wavelength. Violet light (shortest wavelength) has the highest refractive index in glass → bends most. Red light (longest wavelength) bends least. This is why white light splits into VIBGYOR through a prism.

Statement 4 is incorrect: Because different colours have different refractive indices in glass, they also have different critical angles. Violet light, having a higher refractive index, has a smaller critical angle than red light. Dispersion absolutely affects the critical angle - statement 4 contradicts the well-established principle of chromatic dispersion.

Further insights:

Rainbow formation is a natural example of dispersion combined with internal reflection. Sunlight enters spherical raindrops, undergoes refraction, total internal reflection inside the drop, and exits with dispersion - the primary rainbow shows red on the outside (42°) and violet on the inside (40°).

The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram was commissioned by Pallava ruler Narasimhavarman II (also known as Rajasimha) during the early 8th century CE (c. 700 - 728 CE).

The temple is one of the earliest structural stone temples in South India and represents the transition from the Pallava tradition of rock-cut caves and monolithic rathas to free-standing structural temples.

Further Insights:

• The Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984.

• The Shore Temple is one of the earliest surviving structural stone temples in South India.

• Mahabalipuram was an important Pallava port city on the Coromandel Coast.

• The Shore Temple consists of three shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Union Budget:

1) Revenue Receipts are recurring in nature, do not create liabilities, and include tax revenues (direct and indirect taxes) as well as non-tax revenues like dividends from PSUs and fees.

2) Capital Receipts include borrowings by the government and proceeds from disinvestment - they either create liabilities or reduce assets of the government.

3) The Revenue Deficit is the difference between total Revenue Expenditure and total Revenue Receipts, and a persistent Revenue Deficit implies the government is borrowing to meet day-to-day expenses.

4) The Primary Deficit equals the Fiscal Deficit minus the interest payments on past borrowings - it indicates the extent to which the government is borrowing to meet current expenditures excluding interest burden.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
केंद्रीय बजट के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) राजस्व प्राप्तियां (Revenue Receipts) प्रकृति में आवर्ती (recurring) होती हैं, देनदारियां (liabilities) पैदा नहीं करती हैं, और इनमें कर राजस्व (प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रत्यक्ष कर) के साथ-साथ गैर-कर राजस्व जैसे सार्वजनिक उपक्रमों (PSUs) से लाभांश और शुल्क शामिल होते हैं।

2) पूंजीगत प्राप्तियों (Capital Receipts) में सरकार द्वारा लिया गया ऋण और विनिवेश से प्राप्त आय शामिल है - ये या तो देनदारियां पैदा करती हैं या सरकार की संपत्ति को कम करती हैं।

3) राजस्व घाटा (Revenue Deficit) कुल राजस्व व्यय और कुल राजस्व प्राप्तियों के बीच का अंतर है, और लगातार राजस्व घाटे का तात्पर्य है कि सरकार दिन-प्रतिदिन के खर्चों को पूरा करने के लिए उधार ले रही है।

4) प्राथमिक घाटा (Primary Deficit) राजकोषीय घाटे (Fiscal Deficit) में से पिछले उधारों पर ब्याज भुगतान को घटाने के बराबर होता है - यह इंगित करता है कि सरकार ब्याज के बोझ को छोड़कर वर्तमान व्यय को पूरा करने के लिए किस हद तक उधार ले रही है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Revenue receipts flow regularly and do not create repayment obligations. Tax revenue (income tax, GST, customs etc.) and non-tax revenue (interest received, dividends, fees, fines) both form part of revenue receipts.

Statement 2 is correct: Capital receipts are non-recurring. Borrowings (market loans, external borrowings) create future repayment liabilities. Disinvestment proceeds reduce government assets (ownership in PSUs). Both are capital receipts.

Statement 3 is correct: Revenue Deficit = Revenue Expenditure − Revenue Receipts. A positive revenue deficit is fiscally unhealthy - it means the government is financing current consumption (salaries, subsidies, interest payments on revenue account) through borrowings, leaving no surplus for capital investment.

Statement 4 is correct: Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit − Interest Payments. If Primary Deficit is zero, it means the government is borrowing only to service past debt - its current operations are self-financing. A high primary deficit signals structural fiscal imbalance beyond the inherited debt burden.

Further Insights:

Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − Total Receipts (excluding borrowings). It is the most commonly cited deficit indicator. India's FRBM Act (Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003) set targets to reduce fiscal and revenue deficits - though these targets have been revised multiple times, especially post-COVID.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the overall climate of India?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारत की समग्र जलवायु का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है?
questions.solution:
India is broadly described as having a Tropical Monsoon Climate.

This climate is characterized by seasonal reversal of winds, distinct wet and dry seasons, and rainfall that is largely influenced by the southwest and northeast monsoons.

Although India has diverse regional climates due to variations in relief and latitude, the overall climate of the country is classified as tropical monsoon.

Further Insights

The southwest monsoon provides nearly 75% of India's annual rainfall.

The Himalayas prevent cold winds from Central Asia and play a major role in shaping India's climate.

The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) recognizes four main seasons: Winter, Summer, Southwest Monsoon, and Post-Monsoon.

India's climate is influenced by latitude, altitude, distance from the sea, and monsoon winds.

Despite diverse regional climates, India is broadly classified as a Tropical Monsoon country.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the structural distinction between the Kernel and the User Space (Shell/Applications) in an operating system?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में कर्नेल (Kernel) और यूज़र स्पेस (शेल/एप्लिकेशन) के बीच संरचनात्मक अंतर का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: The kernel executes user-installed desktop applications, while the user space directly controls the low-level hardware clock and physical memory allocation.
options.text_hi: कर्नेल उपयोगकर्ता द्वारा इंस्टॉल किए गए डेस्कटॉप एप्लिकेशन निष्पादित करता है, जबकि यूज़र स्पेस सीधे लो-लेवल हार्डवेयर क्लॉक और फिजिकल मेमोरी आवंटन को नियंत्रित करता है।

options.label: B
options.text: The kernel is the central core operating in privileged mode (Kernel Mode) with direct hardware access, whereas user applications execute in restricted User Mode and communicate with the kernel via system calls.
options.text_hi: कर्नेल एक केंद्रीय कोर है जो सीधे हार्डवेयर एक्सेस के साथ विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त मोड (कर्नेल मोड) में काम करता है, जबकि उपयोगकर्ता एप्लिकेशन प्रतिबंधित यूज़र मोड में निष्पादित होते हैं और सिस्टम कॉल के माध्यम से कर्नेल के साथ संचार करते हैं।

options.label: C
options.text: The shell is a hardware microchip attached to the CPU that executes kernel instructions, whereas user space is a physical sector on the secondary hard disk drive.
options.text_hi: शेल CPU से जुड़ी एक हार्डवेयर माइक्रोचिप है जो कर्नेल निर्देशों को निष्पादित करती है, जबकि यूज़र स्पेस सेकेंडरी हार्ड डिस्क ड्राइव पर एक भौतिक (फिजिकल) सेक्टर है।

options.label: D
options.text: The kernel functions as a graphical web browser, while user space serves strictly as a command-line interpreter interface.
options.text_hi: कर्नेल एक ग्राफिकल वेब ब्राउज़र के रूप में कार्य करता है, जबकि यूज़र स्पेस पूरी तरह से कमांड-लाइन इंटरप्रेटर इंटरफ़ेस के रूप में कार्य करता है।

questions.correct_text: The kernel is the central core operating in privileged mode (Kernel Mode) with direct hardware access, whereas user applications execute in restricted User Mode and communicate with the kernel via system calls.
questions.solution:
The Operating System isolates software into privileged execution layers:

Kernel Mode: Possesses unrestricted, direct access to physical memory, CPU instruction sets, and hardware devices.

User Mode: Applications run inside isolated environments to prevent buggy software from crashing the OS. When programs require file I/O or device access, they trigger system calls to request the kernel to perform the action safely.

Further insights:

A Shell (e.g., Command Prompt, Bash, PowerShell) is an interface layer that interprets user commands and sends instructions to the underlying OS kernel.

कर्नेल मोड (Kernel Mode): इसके पास फिजिकल मेमोरी, CPU इंस्ट्रक्शन सेट और हार्डवेयर डिवाइस तक अप्रतिबंधित, सीधा एक्सेस होता है।

II. ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर (लेयर 4) TCP जैसे प्रोटोकॉल का उपयोग करके एंड-टू-एंड संचार प्रवाह नियंत्रण, त्रुटि जाँच और पैकेट रीअसेंबली को संभालती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: Layer 1 deals purely with the hardware medium, mapping bitstreams to voltages, light pulses, or RF frequencies.

Statement II is correct: Layer 4 establishes reliable host-to-host transmission channels, ensuring missing segments are retransmitted in sequence via TCP.

Statement III is incorrect: The description given is for the Session Layer (Layer 5). The Presentation Layer (Layer 6) is responsible for data translation, compression, syntax formatting, and TLS/SSL encryption/decryption layers.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the inner components and register execution cycles of a Central Processing Unit (CPU):

I. The Instruction Register (IR) stores the current instruction fetched from memory while it is being decoded and executed by the Control Unit.

II. The Program Counter (PC) automatically updates its address contents during the fetch phase to point to the next sequential instruction to be executed.

III. The Memory Address Register (MAR) holds the actual data payload or instruction byte that has just been read from, or is about to be written to, the primary RAM.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट (CPU) के आंतरिक घटकों और रजिस्टर निष्पादन चक्रों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. इंस्ट्रक्शन रजिस्टर (IR) मेमोरी से प्राप्त वर्तमान निर्देश को संग्रहीत करता है, जबकि इसे कंट्रोल यूनिट द्वारा डिकोड और निष्पादित किया जा रहा होता है।

II. प्रोग्राम काउंटर (PC) निष्पादित किए जाने वाले अगले अनुक्रमिक निर्देश को इंगित करने के लिए फ़ेच चरण के दौरान अपनी एड्रेस सामग्री को स्वचालित रूप से अपडेट करता है।

III. मेमोरी एड्रेस रजिस्टर (MAR) वास्तविक डेटा पेलोड या निर्देश बाइट को रखता है जिसे अभी-अभी प्राथमिक RAM से पढ़ा गया है, या उसमें लिखा जाने वाला है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: The IR holds the binary machine code of the active instruction so that the Control Unit's microprogrammed or hardwired logic can decode it.

Statement II is correct: The PC updates early in the instruction cycle (during fetch) to ensure the processor tracks the execution sequence.

Statement III is incorrect: The description given is for the Memory Buffer Register (MBR) or Memory Data Register (MDR). The MAR holds exclusively the address of the memory location being targeted.

Hindi:

कथन I सही है: IR सक्रिय निर्देश के बाइनरी मशीन कोड को रखता है ताकि कंट्रोल यूनिट का माइक्रोप्रोग्राम्ड या हार्डवायर्ड लॉजिक इसे डिकोड कर सके।

कथन II सही है: प्रोसेसर निष्पादन अनुक्रम को ट्रैक करता है, यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए निर्देश चक्र (फ़ेच के दौरान) की शुरुआत में PC अपडेट होता है।

कथन III गलत है: दिया गया विवरण मेमोरी बफ़र रजिस्टर (MBR) या मेमोरी डेटा रजिस्टर (MDR) के लिए है। MAR विशेष रूप से लक्षित किए जा रहे मेमोरी स्थान का एड्रेस रखता है।

questions.question: Which of these devices stores data magnetically?

questions.solution:
· Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) store data magnetically on spinning platters coated with a magnetic material. Read/write heads alter the magnetic orientation to represent data (0s and 1s).

Why Not Other Options?

· SSD (Solid State Drive): Uses flash memory (no moving parts; data is stored electronically).

· RAM (Random Access Memory): Volatile electronic memory for temporary data (loses data when powered off).

· ROM (Read-Only Memory): Non-volatile electronic storage (e.g., firmware; not magnetic).

Key Note:

HDDs are slower than SSDs due to mechanical parts but offer cheaper long-term storage.
